title: SK Hynix rises 13% in Nasdaq debut, raising $26.5B in biggest-ever US foreign IPO
summary: SK Hynix opened at $170 (vs $149 offer price) on Nasdaq July 10 under ticker SKHYV, jumping 13% by close. The $26.5B raise surpasses Alibaba's 2014 record. Regular trading begins July 13 as SKHY.
why: 创美国最大外资IPO纪录，AI内存（HBM）需求叙事核心标的，利好SK海力士HK相关衍生品及存储板块（美光/三星）期权隐波上升逻辑。

title: Federal Reserve July 2026 Monetary Policy Report: CPI at 4.2%, rates held at 3.50-3.75%
summary: The Fed's semi-annual report to Congress (released July 10) confirms rates on hold at 3.50-3.75% for the fourth straight meeting. May CPI at 4.2% YoY; PCE forecast revised to 3.6% for 2026. Dot plot shows 9 officials back at least one hike this year.
why: 美联储鹰派立场强化，利率长期高位预期压制成长股估值，影响港股流动性及sell put时对冲成本（波动率结构）；关注7月FOMC会议前后隐波变化。

title: MiniMax解禁首日港股大跌逾20%，市值跌破千亿港元
summary: 逾48%股本（约15.3亿股，市值约594亿港元）7月9日解禁，MiniMax(00100.HK)收跌约18%至297港元，市值降至约932亿港元，较历史高位缩水逾78%。智谱同日解禁反弹13%形成对比。MiniMax同步公告再融资160亿港元，创始人宣布停薪直至实现AGI。
why: 大模型港股解禁潮需关注限售股压力节点；隐波急升时段适合布局sell put策略评估，但需警惕下行断层风险。

title: 证监会就A股再融资规则征求意见：锁价定增退出，全面转向市价发行
summary: 7月3日证监会发布再融资规则修订草案，核心改革：建立储架发行制度、小额快速融资上限翻倍（沪深3亿元提升至6亿元）、所有定增须以发行期首日为定价基准日（废除锁价定增），意见反馈截至8月2日，A股交易新规7月6日起施行。
why: 再融资规则市场化改革降低大股东利用折价定增稀释中小股东权益，中长期对A股持仓正面；储架发行可加快融资节奏，关注持仓A股企业是否有再融资计划。

title: China weighs restricting overseas access to top AI models from Alibaba, ByteDance and Z.ai
summary: China's Ministry of Commerce convened talks with Alibaba (Qwen), ByteDance (Doubao) and Z.ai about limiting foreign access to advanced models, including unreleased ones. Options include barring public release or restricting to domestic use only. No decision reached; any curbs may apply only to future models.
why: 若落地将直接打击阿里云、字节AI海外商业化变现路径；加剧中美科技脱钩叙事，影响组合中所有中概股估值溢价，中短期情绪压制。

title: Circle CRCL faces July 18 GENIUS Act deadline as six US agencies finalize stablecoin rules
summary: Six federal agencies (OCC, FDIC, NCUA, Treasury, FinCEN, OFAC) must publish stablecoin frameworks by July 18, 2026 per GENIUS Act mandate. Rules cover reserve requirements, capital adequacy, and licensing. USDC has $78B market share; stricter requirements could pressure CRCL stock.
why: GENIUS Act落地标志美国稳定币监管正式化，Circle/CRCL合规优势确认；若规则偏严，短期压制CRCL股价，隐波上升期适合重估持仓规模。

title: Tencent leads consortium to buy back AI agent startup Manus from Meta at $2B valuation
summary: After Beijing forced Meta to unwind its $2B Manus acquisition (originally announced Dec 2025), Tencent (0700.HK) leads a consortium with ZhenFund and HSG raising ~$1B to repurchase Manus at original $2B valuation. Tencent would take the largest single stake but remain a minority holder overall.
why: 腾讯主导AI Agent核心资产回购，强化其在中国Agentic AI生态中的战略布局；利好腾讯AI叙事及估值重估，显示中国将AI视为国家主权资产。

title: Alibaba bans employees from Anthropic's Claude Code citing distillation attack security risk
summary: Alibaba classified Claude Code as high-risk software (effective July 10) after Anthropic accused Alibaba-affiliated entities of running 28.8M queries via ~25,000 fraudulent accounts to extract model capabilities. Staff redirected to internal platform Qoder. China government separately issued Claude Code security warning on July 8.
why: 中美AI对抗在企业层面激化，阿里Qoder内部生态闭环加速；Anthropic指控与科技脱钩叙事共振，影响BABA在华AI商业化评估及国际投资者情绪。

title: 阿里巴巴-W(09988.HK) 7月6日斥资4999万美元回购411万股，月内回购节奏持续加码
summary: 阿里巴巴-W发布港交所公告，7月6日斥资4,999.32万美元回购410.87万股；合并6月30日及7月1日两日合计约9,998.78万美元/822万股，今年以来回购持续。
why: 阿里大规模持续回购彰显管理层对当前股价信心，作为sell put持仓标的，回购形成隐性价格底部支撑，有助降低期权风险。

title: Tesla Robotaxi launches in Miami; TSLA stock recovers sharply on FSD expansion optimism
summary: Tesla launched unsupervised Robotaxi service in Miami (July 4) covering 10-14 sq miles of western Miami-Dade — first city outside Texas and California. TSLA stock recovered sharply on FSD optimism; Tesla targets ~12 US states by year-end.
why: 迈阿密Robotaxi扩张是特斯拉FSD商业化里程碑，持续验证无人驾驶收入变现能力；TSLA高贝塔属性下，多重催化驱动隐波变化值得跟踪，影响covered call策略时机。

title: Tesla tests steering-wheel-free Cybercab on Austin roads; commercial deliveries targeted by end-2026
summary: Tesla engineering Cybercab prototypes (no steering wheel, no pedals) began public road testing in Austin, confirmed by Tesla AI head Ashok Elluswamy. Tesla plans commercial Cybercab deliveries by end-2026, with the two-seat vehicle targeting robotaxi fleets.
why: Cybercab路测推进落地时间表，是TSLA机器人出租车叙事的关键催化剂；年底交付目标若实现，将大幅提升FSD订阅+车队运营收入可见度。

title: Palantir and Nvidia launch sovereign AI platform for US government; PLTR surges 7.8%
summary: Palantir (PLTR) and Nvidia announced a sovereign AI initiative running Nemotron models on Blackwell Ultra GPUs in secure on-premise government environments. PLTR closed +7.8% (approx +$21.7B market cap) on the news. Palantir also won the US Army NGC2 command modernization contract.
why: PLTR政府AI合同管道持续加厚，主权AI叙事强化其护城河；PLTR高估值高贝塔，涨势确认后适合评估covered call锁定收益。

title: Alphabet (GOOGL) to report Q2 2026 earnings July 22 — Cloud and Gemini growth in focus
summary: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 results on July 22. Q1 showed Cloud +63% YoY, Gemini enterprise MAU +40% QoQ, Search revenue +19%, EPS $5.11 (+82%). Key watch items: whether AI capex is inflecting into revenue, Waymo monetization update.
why: 7月22日财报是谷歌下一个重要催化剂，云业务增速若维持+60%将支撑估值；期权策略：财报前隐波上升可考虑卖出当周covered call或单周宽跨式策略。

title: Tesla puts Model Y L Launch Series on sale in the US with 12-month free FSD subscription
summary: Tesla began accepting orders for the new Model Y L in the US, with the Launch Series including a complimentary 12-month FSD subscription. The model expands Tesla's SUV lineup targeting family buyers.
why: Model Y L美国上市扩充SUV矩阵，FSD订阅捆绑销售加速渗透率；对Q3交付量有边际正面贡献，与Robotaxi/Cybercab扩张共同构成TSLA多重催化。
